title: Hattie Moll (CMO @ Prosper) — 'Corruption breaks the logic of capitalism itself'
summary: Hattie Moll, CMO at Prosper (the host), captures the sharpest line from the morning — Eric's framing that corruption isn't a moral aberration but a structural failure of the market itself. 29 likes, 3 comments.
blockquote: "Corruption breaks the logic of capitalism itself" and yet here we are, surrounded by an economy that increasingly rewards value destruction over value creation.
blockquote_source: Hattie Moll on LinkedIn (quoting Eric Ries)
